messages:
lina: FYI partner EdgeBox SRE reports mismatch: their proof_of_delivery webhook shows ~12,043 events for 2026-03-14T09:00-09:10Z but our ledger only has ~9,632. I opened PRT-1234.

mike: Can you share a sample payload + headers and whether we saw gateway 5xx in that window?

lina: sample payload (redacted): { "event_id":"evt_20260314_abc123", "client_event_id":"cb1234-0001", "partner_id":"edgebox", "type":"proof_of_delivery", "timestamp":"2026-03-14T09:02:13Z" }  headers: X-Signature, X-Retry-Attempt (0 or 1). We do have gateway 502/504 spikes at ~09:04-09:06.

mike: Pattern looks like partner replays keep client_event_id stable but generate a new event_id on retry. Our dedupe uses event_id only -> undercounts when original delivery failed mid-path. We should dedupe on (partner_id, client_event_id).

sasha: Financial impact estimate ~2.4k events * 1.25 units = ~$3k exposure. Please pause billing for that window until reconciled.

gateway-deploy-bot: gateway-deploy-bot deployed v2.9.1 to prod at 2026-03-14T09:05:12Z (c1a2b3).

mike: Quick plan: 1) hotfix: toggle ingest dedupe_by_client_event flag -> owner mike -> ETA 10:15 PT. 2) backfill: run safe-upsert reconcile over raw webhook archive 09:00-09:15 -> owner mike -> ETA 12:00 PT. 3) ask partner to pause replays -> owner lina -> ETA 09:25. 4) billing hold -> owner sasha -> ETA 09:30.

lina: webhook-ingest logs (09:03:50-09:06:10): 09:03:51 INFO recv id=evt_20260314_abc123 status=200; 09:04:02 ERROR handler timeout id=evt_20260314_def456 status=502; 09:05:18 INFO retry id=evt_20260314_jkl012 retry=1 client_event_id=cb1234-0001.

mike: Opening PR to add safe-upsert and flag: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ingest/pull/462. Will flip flag after partner pauses.

sasha: Need short customer template: 1) we detected duplicate replays affecting ingestion, 2) we're running backfill and will reconcile, 3) billing is on hold for the window until reconciliation. Send by 09:40.

lina: Draft to partner SRE (sent after ack): "We observed replays for client_event_id(s) between 2026-03-14T09:00-09:15Z. Please pause automated retries while we enable dedupe and run a backfill. We'll confirm when it's safe to resume."

lina: Partner SRE acked and paused replays 09:11 UTC.

mike: Flag flipped 09:14:22 UTC. Reconcile run initial results: +2,398 deliveries upserted; ledger now 11,990 for the window (partner reported 12,043). Posting full diff to PRT-1234.

sasha: Billing hold applied; will approve final adjustments once diff is in the ticket. Schedule postmortem for tomorrow.

lina: Actions recorded in PRT-1234. Follow-up scheduled 12:30 PT to confirm billing lift. :thumbsup:
